mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT od.device_code as parentDeviceCode, ( case when length(IFNULL(ten.channel_name, '')) = 0 then t.channel_name else ten.channel_name end ) channelName, t.channel_code, t.channel_status as status, t.visual_range, t.horiz_range, t.verti_range FROM vm_order_devices od LEFT JOIN vm_device_info_t dev ON od.device_code = dev.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_channel_info_t t on od.device_code = t.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_channel_rel_t ten on od.device_code = ten.device_code and ten.tenant_id = od.tenant_id and t.channel_code = ten.channel_code and ten.industry_code = od.industry_code and ten.delete_flag='0' where dev.device_code IS NOT NULL AND t.channel_code IS NOT NULL ${dataScope}
